title: GRACE ACS Risk / Mortality Calculator

changelog.change: Structure + cutoff only; math is proprietary. Per Calculator_Logic_Build_Spec.md.

purpose: In-hospital and 1-3 year mortality in ACS; risk-adjusts disposition and timing to catheterization.

interpretation.label: High risk
interpretation.risk: In-hospital mortality > 3%; ESC 2023 / ACC-AHA 2025 support an early invasive strategy at score > 140

buildNote: GRACE 2.0 is a proprietary non-linear model with no published closed-form equation. Do NOT hand-derive coefficients. Options: (1) license the official calculator logic from gracescore.org, or (2) approximate from published nomogram risk bands and label the result as an approximation in the UI. Confirmed cutoff: score > 140 = high risk. engine='external' renders the input structure and cutoff only until one of those paths is chosen.
